description: Create a new module. Supports workflow modules (states, activities, flows) and record list modules (fields only). Requires Administrator, Consultant, or Workspace Admin role. Validates internally with the same rules as validate_design and returns structured errors without creating anything — a separate validate_design call beforehand is optional. See inistate://schema/configure for field types, color palette, and design rules.

activities.description: Custom activities. Omit for record list modules.

confidence_threshold.description: 0-1; values above 1 are read as percent

card.description: The listing card designed with the schema — how each entry shows in the module's list (mobile and web). Fields and activities by NAME. See CardDefinition in inistate://schema/configure. A card that does not pass never fails the call: the module gets the platform's default card and the response's cardStatus says why.

action.description: 'view' (the default when activities exist), 'edit', or an activity name

field.description: An Image, Images, File, Files or Selection field, by name

size.description: XS | S | M | L (S for a Selection, M for an image)

rows.description: 1–5 rows of 1–3 items: the state row first (or the defaultCard widget alone), the title field L/b, secondary fields S/M, activities in their own row

name.description: Field or activity name; 'defaultCard' for the widget; unused for state

settings.description: defaultCard widget switches (booleans): title, state, assignees, comment, createdBy, createdDate, due, documentId

size.description: S | M | L — Text, number and date fields only

style.description: l | n | b — Text, number and date fields only

type.description: 'grid' when the module has an Image/Images field (the image alone in row 1); otherwise 'detail' with an icon

flows.description: State transition rules: { from, to, activity } by name. Omit for record list modules.

information.description: Field definitions. Items matched by id on update enable renaming.

connection.description: Name of an existing module in this workspace to link to. Required for User/Users/Module/Modules types.

display.description: User/Users/Module/Modules only: name of the connected module's field shown for a picked record. Omit to default (Full Name/Name for users, else the first Text field).

states.description: Workflow states. Omit for record list modules.

color.description: Palette: #5A6070 #2968A8 #2A7B50 #A07828 #C0392B #6B4D91 #1E6B45 #8B2D2D. Names ('red', 'amber') and other hex are normalized to the nearest.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Omit if set via env or set_workspace; required in stateless/remote mode.

name: create_module
title: Create Module
